Application Data.NAME: Hobby Haven LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Hobby Haven LLC specializes in retailing hobby supplies and model kits, offering a wide range of products including remote-controlled vehicles, model trains, arts and crafts materials, and building kits. We also host instructional classes and workshops to help customers enhance their skills in modeling and crafting. Our store is committed to maintaining high-quality customer service and a safe shopping environment, while adhering to all relevant regulations. We have implemented a formal business continuity plan to minimize downtime risks, focusing on inventory management and customer engagement strategies. Please note, we do not offer drone demonstrations or rentals in compliance with regulatory guidelines.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In 2023, Hobby Haven LLC experienced a theft incident where inventory valued at $5,000 was stolen from the store. The loss was reported to the local authorities, and a police report was filed. The status of the claim is currently pending, as the shop is working with local law enforcement to recover the stolen items.
